Row 1: Held the field.Event: **The Department of Improvement** names the battle an improvement
Row 1: Held the field.Accept: It goes in the annual report. Nothing
Row 1: Held the field.Pay: One fighter wears the badge into the next battle, **Announced**: the crew gains **Reliable**
Row 1: Held the field.Twist: Nerve: you give the speech, +1 XP to one fighter / you read the wrong page: lose 2 parts
Nerve: 6 parts / the film makes you the villains: gain Butchers

Row 1: Held the field.Event: **A crowd of bettors** owes the crew
Row 1: Held the field.Twist: Nerve: 8 parts / you swear to double their bets and never turn up: 0 parts, and gain Oathbreakers

Row 1: Held the field.Event: **The loot is stamped.** The Inspectorate wants a fee
Row 1: Held the field.Accept: Pay 4 parts or lose one copy item
Row 1: Held the field.Twist: Tech: forge a stamp, keep everything / pay 8

Row 1: Held the field.Event: **A drifter saw it all** and wants to join
Row 1: Held the field.Accept: One rookie may be hired for 5 parts less
Row 1: Held the field.Twist: Nerve: they are the real thing, hire them free / they were running from someone: hire them free, and write that someone as a **rival**

Row 1: Held the field.Pay: 5 parts: every fighter starts the next battle Hyped

Row 2: Did not hold the field.Twist: Fight: they leave / you promise to pay next week, and don't: lose 4 parts, and gain Oathbreakers
Nerve: "we don't need it", gain **Reliable** / you tell them the crew won't fight again without better odds: 3 parts, and gain Ran

Row 2: Did not hold the field.Event: **Scavengers on the field** after you left
Row 2: Did not hold the field.Pay: One fighter takes no task and goes back for it tonight: you get back one item lost this battle
Row 2: Did not hold the field.Twist: Grit: get one back free / one fighter is Sore

Row 2: Did not hold the field.Accept: The newest fighter (lowest Experience) gets the silly trait "Jittery" (section 13.7)
Row 2: Did not hold the field.Pay: 3 parts: a pep talk with drinks
Row 2: Did not hold the field.Twist: Nerve: they shrug it off / they leave the crew (their gear stays)
Tech: it finds a real lesson, +1 XP to one fighter / it insists; one fighter starts the next battle Shook

Row 2: Did not hold the field.Event: **Named on the boards.** The winners' victory speech names your captain
Row 2: Did not hold the field.Pay: The captain writes the reply on the boards and starts the next battle **Announced**: the crew gains **Showboats**
Row 2: Did not hold the field.Twist: Nerve: the captain answers in person, +1 XP / they get the silly trait "Big talk"

Row 3: Ran.Pay: Cross off a contact, or pay 6 parts: a quiet word with the rumour board, and no tag
Row 3: Ran.Twist: Nerve: no tag / gain Ran and Oathbreakers

Row 3: Ran.Event: **The patron withholds pay** and keeps the deposit
Row 3: Ran.Twist: Fight: they pay up after all, +5 parts / gain Ran

Row 3: Ran.Accept: One fighter that was evacuated gets the silly trait "Spent your luck"
Row 3: Ran.Twist: Nerve: they are fine / the trait, and gain Ran

Row 3: Ran.Event: **Wise retreat.** A Control Group observer notes it
Row 3: Ran.Twist: Tech: the paper cites you as the one crew that does what it says, gain Oathkeepers / it calls you a control sample, gain Ran
Tech: the bill has an error in your favour, 0 / pay 6

Row 3: Ran.Event: **Someone else's pod.** An arrival from a pod nobody claimed wanders into your camp
Row 3: Ran.Twist: Nerve: you tell them who they were, and they believe it: they join, and the player picks their rumour now / they don't believe you, and wander off

Row 4: Lost someone.Accept: Every fighter takes no task this break
Row 4: Lost someone.Pay: 5 parts: a quick one, tasks as normal

Row 4: Lost someone.Accept: One fighter writes a Big Word on their card now, a vow for the next battle (section 13.5)
Row 4: Lost someone.Twist: Nerve: the whole crew swears; every fighter starts the next battle Hyped / nobody can speak: the crew swears no Words next battle

Row 4: Lost someone.Accept: The crew drinks to them: lose 3 parts
Row 4: Lost someone.Twist: Nerve: someone tells the story right, +1 XP to one fighter / it turns into a fight: one fighter is Sore

Row 4: Lost someone.Event: **Their gear is claimed** by a creditor
Row 4: Lost someone.Accept: Lose one item the lost fighter carried
Row 4: Lost someone.Pay: Write the creditor as a **rival**: keep it

Row 4: Lost someone.Event: **A relative turns up** to fill the space
Row 4: Lost someone.Accept: Hire one rookie for 5 parts less, same species as the lost fighter
Row 4: Lost someone.Twist: Nerve: they take the lost fighter's title with a prefix, and start the next battle Hyped / they want the lost fighter's gear: give them one item

Row 4: Lost someone.Event: **Revenge.** The crew that did it is written on the roster as a **rival**
Row 4: Lost someone.Twist: Nerve: one fighter swears it, and starts the next battle Hyped / they swear it too loudly: Announced

Row 5: Took a captive or paid a ransom.Twist: Nerve: 8 parts / it lied, and you forgive it: gain Merciful
Nerve: you send one back, gain Showboats / you send back the captive's boots with a note: gain Butchers

Row 5: Took a captive or paid a ransom.Event: **The ransom was counterfeit** (if you received one)
Row 5: Took a captive or paid a ransom.Twist: Tech: the stamps are real / lose 6

Row 5: Took a captive or paid a ransom.Event: **The paid-for fighter is grateful** (if you paid one)
Row 5: Took a captive or paid a ransom.Accept: They start the next battle Hyped
Row 5: Took a captive or paid a ransom.Twist: Nerve: they swear to repay it, and start Hyped and Under warranty / they resent being bought: Flustered instead
Tech: you print a price list, Reliable and 3 parts / it has a typo, and "ransoms" reads "bodies". People believe it: gain Butchers
Tech: the forms are in order / pay 5, and the clerk files the captive as "returned unharmed": gain Merciful

Row 6: Made a legend.Event: **The song is wrong.** It is about someone else
Row 6: Made a legend.Twist: Nerve: it is about you, +1 XP / it is about the enemy
Nerve: the legend signs everything, 2 parts / a fan follows them into the next fight: they start it Announced

Row 6: Made a legend.Event: **A patron wants the legend** for a job
Row 6: Made a legend.Accept: The legend takes it instead of their task: 5 parts
Row 6: Made a legend.Twist: Fight: 10 parts / the legend is Sore

Row 6: Made a legend.Event: **The Annual Improvement Awards** nominate the fighter
Row 6: Made a legend.Accept: Nothing (they lose to a harvest figure)
Row 6: Made a legend.Twist: Nerve: they win Fighter of the Year, +2 XP / they get the silly trait "Big talk"

Row 6: Made a legend.Accept: A rookie may be hired for 5 parts less; they insist on the same title with a prefix
Row 6: Made a legend.Twist: Nerve: the legend trains them, hire them free / the imitator is better at it: the legend gets the silly trait "Big talk"

Row 6: Made a legend.Accept: The fighter starts the next battle Hyped
Row 6: Made a legend.Twist: Nerve: they tell it themselves, +1 XP / they oversell it: they write a Big Word on their card now for the next battle

Row 7: The Bodgers.Event: **The roof comes in.** The wreck-home was held up by tape and hope
Row 7: The Bodgers.Accept: One fighter of the crew's choice is **Sore** (they held the beam)
Row 7: The Bodgers.Pay: Cross off a contact: a friend turns up with a ladder, and nobody is hurt
Row 7: The Bodgers.Twist: Tech: you tape it better than it ever was, and one fighter starts the next battle **Under warranty** / it falls in again: two fighters are **Sore**

Row 7: The Bodgers.Event: **Dipstick thinks out loud** about your next fight, all night, one step at a time
Row 7: The Bodgers.Pay: One fighter stays up to listen and takes no task: gain a **lead**
Row 7: The Bodgers.Twist: Tech: you hear the wrong step and say so, +1 XP to one fighter / you follow it to the end: one fighter starts the next battle **Shook**

Row 7: The Bodgers.Event: **One of ours is stuck** down a wreck, and calling
Row 7: The Bodgers.Pay: One fighter takes no task and goes down after them: the crew gains **Merciful**
Row 7: The Bodgers.Twist: Grit: you haul them out, and they owe you: gain a contact of your choice, and the crew gains **Merciful** / the wreck shifts: the fighter is **Sore**, and the Bodger is still down there

Row 7: The Bodgers.Event: **A claim on your claim** (Red Tape). Another crew has filed against the item you claimed
Row 7: The Bodgers.Accept: Lose one copy item: their paperwork was better
Row 7: The Bodgers.Pay: Write the claimant as a **rival**: keep the item
Row 7: The Bodgers.Twist: Tech: yours was filed first and they withdraw: the crew gains **Reliable** / wrong colour of ink: lose the item, and one fighter starts the next battle **Announced** (their name is on the form)

Row 7: The Bodgers.Event: **A collector watches the restoration** (Silver Tape). They stand and watch a wreck go from scrap to shine
Row 7: The Bodgers.Pay: Give the collector a copy item: gain the contact **Fence**
Row 7: The Bodgers.Twist: Nerve: they love the talk and tell everyone: the crew gains **Showboats** / they ask a question you cannot answer: the fighter gets the silly trait "Big talk"

Row 7: The Bodgers.Event: **The pod queue** (Black Tape). It moves a yard a day, and the whole camp is in it
Row 7: The Bodgers.Accept: Nothing. The queue moves a yard
Row 7: The Bodgers.Pay: One fighter takes no task and queues all night: roll on the **finds** table
Row 7: The Bodgers.Twist: Fight: you take the front of the queue: roll twice on the finds table and keep one / the queue takes it badly: the fighter is **Sore**

Row 7: The Inspectorate.Event: **Surprise audit.** A superior from another district goes through your papers
Row 7: The Inspectorate.Accept: Two fighters of the crew's choice take no task: they sit with the auditor
Row 7: The Inspectorate.Pay: Cross off a contact: they vouch for you, and nobody sits
Row 7: The Inspectorate.Twist: Tech: every form is in order, and the auditor salutes: the crew gains **Reliable** / a stamp is upside down: lose 3 parts, and two fighters take no task

Row 7: The Inspectorate.Accept: Filed under C, for Complaint. Nothing
Row 7: The Inspectorate.Twist: Nerve: you apologise, and mean it: the crew gains **Merciful** / you fine them for complaining, and everyone remembers the face: that fighter starts the next battle **Announced**

Row 7: The Inspectorate.Event: **New hats.** The district issues one size to every crew
Row 7: The Inspectorate.Accept: The smallest fighter starts the next battle **Flustered** (the hat is over their eyes)
Row 7: The Inspectorate.Pay: One fighter takes no task and takes in the hats: up to three fighters start the next battle **Hyped** (it fits)
Row 7: The Inspectorate.Twist: Nerve: the captain wears two hats and looks it: the captain starts the next battle **Hyped** and **Announced** / the hat catches in the door: the captain is **Sore**

Row 7: The Inspectorate.Event: **A merchant and a very heavy crate** (Weights and Measures). They have to cross your scale
Row 7: The Inspectorate.Accept: The scale says what it says: **+3 parts**
Row 7: The Inspectorate.Twist: Tech: you lean on the scale: **+8 parts** / the merchant spots it: write them as a **rival**, and give back 3 parts

Row 7: The Inspectorate.Event: **Your annual review** (Department of Improvement). Very cheerful
Row 7: The Inspectorate.Accept: "Meets expectations." It goes in the report. Nothing
Row 7: The Inspectorate.Pay: The captain takes no task and writes the self-assessment: +1 XP to the captain
Row 7: The Inspectorate.Twist: Nerve: "Exceeds expectations": one fighter gains +1 XP and the crew gains **Showboats** / "Needs improvement": the captain gets the silly trait "Big talk"

Row 7: The Inspectorate.Event: **A controlled burn** (Fire Marshals). The standing orders say your camp must be set alight once a quarter, for safety, and it is your quarter
Row 7: The Inspectorate.Accept: Lose one copy item of the crew's choice (it was in the tent)
Row 7: The Inspectorate.Pay: One fighter takes no task and carries the gear out: lose nothing
Row 7: The Inspectorate.Twist: Grit: you save the lot, and the Marshals pin a medal on the fighter: +1 XP / the fighter is **Sore**, and the item is lost

Row 7: The Waiting.Event: **A heretic at the fire** says the gate is dead
Row 7: The Waiting.Accept: One fighter of the crew's choice starts the next battle **Flustered** (a doubt is a doubt)
Row 7: The Waiting.Pay: One fighter takes no task and argues with them all night: +1 XP
Row 7: The Waiting.Twist: Nerve: the heretic stays to listen, and knows something: gain a **lead** / you begin to wonder: one fighter gets the silly trait "Jittery"

Row 7: The Waiting.Event: **A pod lands in the night.** The sky has spoken, and the crew gathers to sing at it
Row 7: The Waiting.Pay: One fighter opens it and starts the next battle **Shook** (the blasphemy): roll on the **drop** table (section 9.7). An arrival from it joins as usual
Row 7: The Waiting.Twist: Nerve: the priest blesses it first: roll on the drop table, and nobody is Shook / the sky is displeased: the fighter who opened it is **Sore**, and the pod is empty

Row 7: The Waiting.Event: **A relic with a plaque** turns up in the baggage: VOID IF REMOVED
Row 7: The Waiting.Twist: Nerve: the priest knows what it is: one relic may be bought this break at half price, with no roll for a seller / it was a desk bell, and the fighter who rang it starts the next battle **Announced**

Row 7: The Waiting.Event: **The answer, word for word** (the Listeners). A Listener told a stranger what the voice said, as their own thought, and the stranger acted on it
Row 7: The Waiting.Twist: Nerve: it was good advice, and the stranger is grateful: gain the contact **Informer** / it was bad advice, and they want a word: write them as a **rival**

Row 7: The Waiting.Event: **The prophecy** (the Visionaries). A Longshanks Visionary says one of your fighters will not be standing at the end of the next battle. Which one is up to you
Row 7: The Waiting.Accept: The player picks the fighter: they start the next battle **Shook** (they heard)
Row 7: The Waiting.Pay: That fighter swears a Big Word now (a vow, on their card for the next battle): nothing else happens
Row 7: The Waiting.Twist: Nerve: they laugh at it: +1 XP / they believe it: **Shook** and **Flustered**

Row 7: The Waiting.Event: **A long walk** (the Pilgrims). The signs say the next place is the right place, and it is
Row 7: The Waiting.Twist: Nerve: you start the singing, and everyone joins: every fighter starts the next battle **Hyped** / you forget the words: one fighter starts the next battle **Flustered**, and nobody will say whose fault it was

Row 7: Ledgerhands.Event: **The account arrives.** Jeminy sends the crew's balance, with a friendly note
Row 7: Ledgerhands.Accept: If the crew's parts are below 0, lose another 3 (interest). Otherwise nothing
Row 7: Ledgerhands.Pay: One fighter takes no task and argues with the clerk: no interest
Row 7: Ledgerhands.Twist: Nerve: they waive it, and the clerk writes that you pay on the day: the crew gains **Oathkeepers** / "It is going well": lose 3 parts, even if that takes the crew below 0

Row 7: Ledgerhands.Event: **A fighter signed something** at the air meter without reading it, and Jeminy has the copy
Row 7: Ledgerhands.Accept: That fighter must Work a job this break, if they can
Row 7: Ledgerhands.Pay: Cross off a contact: a friend with a lawyer finds the clause
Row 7: Ledgerhands.Twist: Nerve: you honour it to the letter, and word gets round: gain **Oathkeepers** / you tear it up in front of the clerk: gain **Oathbreakers**, and the fighter is free

Row 7: Ledgerhands.Event: **The mark's friends** know who named them
Row 7: Ledgerhands.Accept: Write the crew whose fighter you named as your mark as a **rival**
Row 7: Ledgerhands.Twist: Nerve: you send a receipt, and a note saying it was only business: no rival, and the crew gains **Reliable** / they read the note aloud at their camp: the rival stands, and one fighter starts the next battle **Announced**

Row 7: Ledgerhands.Event: **The creditor inspects the gear** (the Indentured). It is their gear, and they want to know why it is dented
Row 7: Ledgerhands.Accept: One fighter of the crew's choice starts the next battle **Shook** (a lecture on dents)
Row 7: Ledgerhands.Pay: Cross off a contact: a friend swears it was like that when it arrived
Row 7: Ledgerhands.Twist: Nerve: you show them what the gear has done, and they let you keep the dents: one fighter gains +1 XP / they add the dents to the debt: lose 3 parts

Row 7: Ledgerhands.Event: **The last good boots** (Collections Department). A debtor has nothing left but a good pair of boots
Row 7: Ledgerhands.Accept: You take the boots: a copy armour worth up to 5 parts, and the crew gains **Butchers**
Row 7: Ledgerhands.Pay: Leave them the boots: the crew gains **Merciful**, and the debtor remembers it: gain the contact **Informer**
Row 7: Ledgerhands.Twist: Fight: the debtor's cousin has been waiting in the stairwell, and loses: you take a copy weapon worth up to 5 parts as well / the cousin wins: the fighter is **Sore**, and the boots are theirs

Row 7: Ledgerhands.Event: **Account deactivated** (Per-Diem Companies). The platform has decided a fighter is "not a good fit", and will not say why
Row 7: Ledgerhands.Accept: One fighter of the crew's choice takes no task this break
Row 7: Ledgerhands.Pay: Cross off a contact: a human at the platform reads the appeal
Row 7: Ledgerhands.Twist: Tech: the appeal goes through, and the platform apologises with a bonus: +1 XP to that fighter / the appeal gets one star: that fighter starts the next battle **Flustered**

Row 7: The Control Group.Event: **The ethics board visits** the field team and asks to see the consent forms
Row 7: The Control Group.Pay: One fighter takes no task and fills in every form: the crew gains **Merciful**
Row 7: The Control Group.Twist: Tech: the board approves, "broadly humane": the crew gains **Merciful**, and one bot gains +1 XP (they asked it questions) / the board wants the forms in person: two fighters take no task

Row 7: The Control Group.Event: **A bot asks a question** nobody programmed: "Why?"
Row 7: The Control Group.Pay: One fighter takes no task and answers it: one bot gains +1 XP
Row 7: The Control Group.Twist: Tech: the bot understands and writes it down: one bot gains +2 XP / the answer breaks something: that bot is **Sore**

Row 7: The Control Group.Event: **Thank you for your participation.** An Observer thanks the crew for taking part in a study nobody mentioned
Row 7: The Control Group.Pay: One fighter takes no task and asks what the study is: gain a **lead** (the answer: "it concerns you")
Row 7: The Control Group.Twist: Nerve: it tells you, and a volunteer passes it on: gain the contact **Informer** / it thanks the fighter again, at length: they start the next battle **Flustered**

Row 7: The Control Group.Event: **The same result, again** (Replication Wing). A cheap bot repeats one action all night, until somebody writes it down as proof
Row 7: The Control Group.Pay: One bot takes no task and repeats it: +1 XP to that bot
Row 7: The Control Group.Twist: Tech: replicated: the crew gains **Reliable** / failed to replicate: that bot is **Sore**

Row 7: The Control Group.Event: **Sweeping conclusions** (Observation Wing). They watched a few people for a long time, and now tell everyone what everyone is like
Row 7: The Control Group.Accept: The report calls the crew "unremarkable". Nothing
Row 7: The Control Group.Twist: Tech: the sample was you, and the finding is flattering: the crew gains **Reliable** / the finding is that you run from danger: the crew gains **Ran**

Row 7: The Control Group.Event: **The Dissenters were right** (the Dissenters). Their own numbers say the crew's method is wrong. Nobody likes them
Row 7: The Control Group.Pay: One fighter takes no task and checks the numbers: +1 XP to one fighter
Row 7: The Control Group.Twist: Tech: they are right, and you fix it: one bot gains +2 XP / they are right, and you did not check: one fighter starts the next battle **Shook**

Row 7: Hollowood.Event: **Reshoots.** The studio wants the battle again, from a better angle
Row 7: Hollowood.Accept: Nothing. They use what they have
Row 7: Hollowood.Pay: Two fighters take no task and re-enact it: the crew gains **Showboats**
Row 7: Hollowood.Twist: Nerve: it looks better the second time: one fighter gains +1 XP / the extras were better: one fighter starts the next battle **Flustered**

Row 7: Hollowood.Event: **A fan letter** for a fighter nobody has heard of
Row 7: Hollowood.Accept: The crew's newest fighter starts the next battle **Hyped** (somebody believes in them)
Row 7: Hollowood.Twist: Nerve: the fan is real, and rich: gain the contact **Patron** / the fan is the studio's lawyer: lose 3 parts

Row 7: Hollowood.Event: **Confessional** (Reality Productions). Every fighter gets a booth and a question
Row 7: Hollowood.Accept: One fighter of the crew's choice says something they regret, and starts the next battle **Announced**
Row 7: Hollowood.Pay: The captain takes no task and writes the lines: nobody says anything
Row 7: Hollowood.Twist: Nerve: the clip is the line of the week: one fighter gains +1 XP / the clip gives away the next battle's plan: that fighter starts **Announced** and **Shook**

Row 7: Hollowood.Event: **The algorithm recommends you** (Streaming Platforms). It thinks you are similar to something else
Row 7: Hollowood.Accept: The crew's most experienced fighter starts the next battle **Announced** (everyone saw the thumbnail)
Row 7: Hollowood.Twist: Tech: you pick the thumbnail: that fighter is also **Hyped**, and the crew gains 3 parts / wrong thumbnail: that fighter is also **Flustered**

Row 7: Hollowood.Event: **The director has a new idea** (Festival Auteurs). It involves one fighter, a window and no explanation
Row 7: Hollowood.Accept: One fighter of the crew's choice starts the next battle **Flustered** (they were told to do it differently)
Row 7: Hollowood.Pay: The Director takes no task and explains it: nobody is Flustered
Row 7: Hollowood.Twist: Nerve: it is "bold": the Director gains +1 XP / nobody understands it, and the fighter walks off set: they are **Sore**

Row 7: Hollowood.Event: **The sequel** (Franchise Studios). The same picture, only bigger
Row 7: Hollowood.Accept: Nothing. The studio is still counting
Row 7: Hollowood.Pay: One fighter takes no task and rehearses the big finish: +1 XP
Row 7: Hollowood.Twist: Nerve: the audience loves the same thing again: the crew gains **Showboats** / it opens badly: that fighter gets the silly trait "Big talk"
